mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 34 degrees with overcast skies at Harriet Park under a Waning Gibbous moon.

For those interested in local government, the City Clerk has released candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election. You have until January 5 to submit your paperwork for any of the four Aldermanic districts up for election.
It is a busy couple of days in town with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today and the 50-year craft brewing celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company also happening today.
In police news, on November 4, a driver was arrested for O W I in a business parking lot on East Verona Avenue after police found a minor in the vehicle.
Satisfy your cravings with today's flavor, Snickers Swirl. The store opens today at 10:00 AM.
